value.answer: OAuth apps can now register up to 10 redirect URIs, facilitating support for multiple environments, domains, or configurations without needing separate apps. Developers can add additional URLs through the new Add redirect URI button in their application settings. OAuth apps can also opt in to expiring access tokens and refresh tokens, enhancing security.
